connector.name: Apiverket
connector.registryDescription: Query Swedish public data: companies, SCB statistics, weather, transport, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package apiverket-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vinvuk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
